en: Black‑and‑white postcard with two panoramic photographs of a large historic estate surrounded by trees and lawns. The upper photo shows a partly obscured mansion behind tall trees; the lower photo shows a grand, ornate castle-like building with towers and a wide lawn in front, where a few animals (likely cows or horses) are grazing. Dutch captions identify the site as Kasteel Oud Wassenaar and note a connection with The Hague. There is some faint handwritten text beneath the printed postcard image.
